Sends custom headers on same-host crawl requests

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"custom_headers\":{\"Accept-Language\":\"en-US\",\"X-Custom-Header\":\"test-value\"},\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"subdomain_header_allowlist\":[\"Accept-Language\"]}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.CrawlAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages.Count);
```
